groups.publication_safeguard: No rank-deficient/Gram exception; any required unresolved eigenvalue/condition screen blocks relevant covariance/publication result.

groups.publication_safeguard: Preserve negative tiny eigenvalues and all raw values; do not clip or claim PSD/algebraic rank from a numerical threshold.
groups.remaining_decision_or_fact: Approve matrix/eigenvalue requirements independently of P7 raw-condition exception.
